title: Nash Bargaining Characterization in Lean
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We describe a Lean 4 formalization of the classical two-person Nash bargaining characterization. A bargaining problem consists of a compact convex subset of the real plane, a feasible disagreement point, and a feasible outcome strictly improving both utilities. The Nash product is maximized over the individually rational part of that set.
